import json
from pathlib import Path
with Path('/fixture/public-events.jsonl').open('rb') as stream:
    raw = stream.read(4097)
if len(raw) > 4096:
    raise ValueError('input limit')
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines() if line]
print(json.dumps({'count': len(rows), 'accepted': sum(row.get('kind') == 'accepted' for row in rows)}))
